sources.entry: TeamStatus-for-GitHub - macOS status bar application for tracking code review process within the team.

summary.one_liner: A macOS status bar app that helps a team track its code review process on GitHub.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a macOS status bar application for tracking the code review process within a team. A prebuilt TeamStatus.app.zip is offered for download. Setup requires creating a GitHub personal access token with the "repo" scope. The app is launched from Terminal with `open -a TeamStatus.app --args accessToken`, passing the token as an argument. The README does not describe the specific views, filters, or notifications the app provides.
use_cases: track pull request reviews across a team
see review status from the macOS menu bar
how_to_run: Download TeamStatus.app.zip from the link in the README and unzip it.
On GitHub, go to Settings -> Developer settings -> Personal access tokens and generate a new token with the "repo" scope.
In Terminal, run: open -a TeamStatus.app --args accessToken (replace accessToken with your token).
notable: Lives in the macOS status bar
Prebuilt app available, no build step described
Authenticates with a GitHub personal access token passed on the command line
caveats: Requires a GitHub personal access token with full "repo" scope
Token is passed as a command-line argument, which may be visible in shell history
README is brief and gives no details on features or maintenance status
